title: Solve optimal and minimax paths
frozenQuestion: In every retained S05 family and for every retained structural start, what are the exact successful-path shortest and lexicographic minimum-cost labels, and under each independent S06 metric what is the exact minimum peak excursion or separate unsuccessful class?

goalAndSchedulerSemantics.goalSet: all and only S05 terminal_code=1 complete nodes
goalAndSchedulerSemantics.unreachableActive: active start with no finite path to the complete goal set
goalAndSchedulerSemantics.quantification: existential over finite labelled S05 structural-opportunity paths
excludedClaims: probability or expectation under marginal edge weights

allStateSolutions.shortest: minimum activations to any complete node on the full directed multigraph
allStateSolutions.witnessRepresentation: one deterministic physical S05 local edge index per reachable non-goal start for each all-state solution; terminal and unsuccessful starts use -1

secondaryMinimaxWitnesses.definition: after fixing a selected start's exact primary bottleneck, solve each frozen S06 cost profile in the induced subgraph of vertices whose metric level is at most that start-specific bottleneck
secondaryMinimaxWitnesses.representation: explicit ordered node and physical local-edge lists for a deterministic stratified audit panel
secondaryMinimaxWitnesses.reasonNotAnAllStateForest: a continuation optimal under start threshold B(s) need not be optimal under the continuation node's smaller B(u); one successor per node therefore cannot encode every start-conditioned secondary optimum
secondaryMinimaxWitnesses.selection: deterministic coverage of metrics, outcome classes with successful paths, n, architecture, direction, policy profile, fault mode/count, deepest excursions, and largest graph boundaries

determinism.edgeTieBreak: lowest physical local edge index among equal lexicographic cost labels; primary minimax inherits the frozen S06 reverse-bucket first-discovery order
determinism.nodeTieBreak: lowest state ordinal in equal-priority heaps
determinism.integerArithmetic: exact signed integer labels; -1 only in serialized undefined fields

budgets.rule: stop and report any trigger; do not omit a family, state, metric, cost profile, or terminal class and do not change goal/scheduler semantics

validationGates: all-state shortest and lexicographic Bellman equations
all-state minimax Bellman equation and exact class accounting
successor-edge source, endpoint, label, and strict progress checks
explicit primary and secondary witness replay
independent threshold-reachability oracle on every n=4 family and all metrics
independent tiny brute-force lexicographic solver checks
physical output schema, key uniqueness, logical digest, and deterministic rerun samples
